import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD_A = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD_B = 998244353L;
    static final int MAX_DEPTH = 7;
    static final long MULT = 1000000L;

    static long limit_value;
    static long order_count;
    static int total_res;
    static int[] prefix_sum_arr = new int[MAX_DEPTH];
    static List<Integer>[] digit_vectors = new ArrayList[MAX_DEPTH];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DEPTH; i++) {
            digit_vectors[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void generate(int start, int depth) {
        order_count++;
        digit_vectors[depth].add((int)(((order_count - start) % MOD_B + MOD_B) % MOD_B));
        prefix_sum_arr[depth] = (int)((prefix_sum_arr[depth] + digit_vectors[depth].get(digit_vectors[depth].size() - 1)) % MOD_A);
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            generate(start * 10 + d, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    static void process(long x) {
        if (x > limit_value) return;
        if (x * MULT + MULT - 1 <= limit_value && x * MULT * 10 > limit_value) {
            long saved_order = order_count;
            for (int depth = 0, factor = 1; depth <= 6; depth++, factor *= 10) {
                List<Integer> vec = digit_vectors[depth];
                int size = vec.size();
                int diff = (int)(((saved_order - x * factor) % MOD_B + MOD_B) % MOD_B);
                int target = (int)(Collections.binarySearch(vec, (int)(MOD_B - diff)) >= 0 ? 
                                   (int)(Collections.binarySearch(vec, (int)(MOD_B - diff))) : 
                                   -Collections.binarySearch(vec, (int)(MOD_B - diff)) - 1);
                int pos = target;
                total_res = (int)((total_res + 1L * diff * size + prefix_sum_arr[depth]) % MOD_A);
                int subtractVal = (int)((1L * MOD_B * (size - pos)) % MOD_A);
                total_res = (total_res - subtractVal + (int)MOD_A) % (int)MOD_A;
                order_count += size;
            }
            return;
        }
        order_count++;
        total_res = (int)((total_res + ((order_count - x) % MOD_B + MOD_B) % MOD_B) % MOD_A);
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            process(x * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        limit_value = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        order_count = 0;
        generate(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(digit_vectors[i]);
        }
        order_count = 0;
        total_res = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            process(i);
        }
        System.out.println(total_res);
    }
}
